facts.claim: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, Roper reported net revenue of $4.2042 billion versus $3.8264 billion a year earlier; Q2 revenue was $2.1089 billion versus $1.9436 billion.
Q2 2026 income from operations was $584.7 million versus $548.3 million in Q2 2025, while net interest expense increased to $111.4 million from $79.1 million.

factors.name: financialOperatingMomentum
factors.basis: SEC-filed Q2 and first-half revenue and operating income increased year over year.

factors.name: thesisQuality
factors.basis: Independent regulatory filing corroborates continued portfolio-level revenue growth rather than relying only on issuer-hosted release lineage.

factors.name: pricingPower
factors.basis: The filing supports operating growth but does not isolate price versus volume sufficiently for Scout to infer pricing power.

risks.risk: Net interest expense increased materially year over year, raising the hurdle rate for acquisition-led capital deployment.

contradictions.claim: Operating growth coexists with a higher financing burden.
contradictions.resolution: Both are directly supported by the SEC filing; Alpha should preserve the financing burden as a risk rather than netting it away against growth.

unknowns.unknown: This source does not establish market valuation opportunity or acquisition-level returns; those remain Alpha-owned.
